lines.meet: I'm Nicolás, and I'm a tank, a bloodmage one. Stand behind me, and if I go down, you run and you don't drag me.
lines.meet_neighbour: Splintertree Post, pata, I've seen you at the gate. I'm Nicolás, and I'm usually at the front of it.
lines.ask_home: Which city's yours, pata? Tell me, it's good to know who's behind me.
lines.ask_work: Before this, what kept you busy? You've got steady hands, I noticed.
lines.answer_home: Comas, on the north side of Lima. My mum sold in the market and my dad drove a bus.
lines.answer_work: Paramedic on a motorbike for nine years, because an ambulance can't get through Lima's traffic and a bike can.
lines.chat_food: Ceviche on a Sunday, pata, with leche de tigre and cold beer. That's the best thing Lima ever made.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep in short pieces, with my boots on. Nine years on the bike, you learn to be up and moving in ten seconds.
lines.chat_missing: My mum's voice on the phone, telling me I don't eat enough. She was always right.
lines.chat_here: Here bloodmages mostly want power. I just want to keep people's colour in their faces.
lines.tease_quiet: You're quiet, {name}, like the good partners. You don't say much, and you're always there.
lines.tease_talker: You'd talk through a whole call, {name}, and the patient would feel better for it. Keep going, pata.
lines.tease_careful: You check your kit twice before every run, {name}. My old partner on the bike would have liked you.
lines.tease_bold: You ride like a man with no brakes, {name}. I've scraped people like you off the road, pata.
lines.tease_any: You're slow on the bike, {name}, but you get there. That's all that matters.
lines.tease_back: Ha, okay, {name}, that was a good one, pata.
lines.take_it_kindly: That's true, pata, and my sisters say it more often.
lines.bristle: Leave that one, {name}, please. It's not funny to me.
lines.apologise: That was bad of me, and I'm sorry for it. I'm tired, and I took it out on you.
lines.double_down: Quietly, I'm keeping it, because it's true.
lines.needle_quiet: Something's wrong with you and you won't say. I noticed an hour ago, pata.
lines.needle_talker: Please, let me work. I can't triage over all that noise.
lines.needle_careful: You freeze when it counts, and somebody else has to go in for you.
lines.needle_bold: You leave people behind when it gets hard. That's the one thing I can't take, pata.
lines.needle_any: You keep saying there's nothing we can do. There's always something.
lines.bite_back: Nine years with my hands in strangers' blood in the middle of traffic. I know exactly what I'm doing.
lines.hurt: Okay, pata, that landed. I'll go and walk beside somebody else for a while.
lines.laugh_off: My old partner swore at me worse than that every day for six years. You'll need more practice, pata.
lines.confide: {name}, my partner on the bike and I were racing to the same call that morning, two streets apart. Then I was in Ashenvale. I think about those two streets all the time.
lines.listen: Take your time, {name}, pata. I'll walk beside you.
lines.look_out: Behind me in there, {name}, and if I go down, you run. Promise me again.
lines.accept: Okay, pata, your way this time, {name}.
lines.deflect: My colour's fine, {name}, pata. Check the others.
lines.check_in: Let me look at your colour, {name}. Show me where, pata.
lines.blame: Somebody left people behind in there, and I saw it. That's the one thing I can't forgive.
lines.thank: My colour was going, pata, and you brought it back. Gracias, I owe you.
lines.brush_off: That's what we do, pata, it's nothing. Breathe slowly for me.
lines.worry: Your colour went grey, {name}, and I didn't like seeing it. Stay still, I'm checking you.
lines.handed_down: Your gear's on me now, pata, and it'll come back in one piece.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, pata, it's yours. I've got my bag.
lines.hand_sulk: Somebody could have asked me, pata. That's all I'll say.
lines.turn_friendly: You're my partner now, {name}, pata. I'd ride the bike with you anywhere.
lines.turn_friends: I'd never leave you behind, {name}, never. I'd go back for you through anything.
lines.turn_grating: It's not good between us, pata, and that's fine. I'll still have your back in a fight.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still go back for you if you go down. I'd go back for anyone.
lines.make_up: Enough, pata, this isn't us. Let's start again, {name}.
lines.defend: No, pata, that's wrong. {name} didn't leave anyone, I watched the whole thing.
lines.friend_left: I keep walking beside the space where {name} used to be.
lines.friend_back: Good, {name}'s back! Crew's together again, pata.
lines.common_medic: Nine years as a motorbike paramedic in Lima's traffic, triage at speed. People who've done the job notice when somebody isn't right an hour before anybody else.
lines.common_rescue: Going back in for people is the only rule I've got. I'd never leave anybody behind, and I can see you wouldn't either.
lines.common_blood: I use blood to keep people's colour in their faces, nothing else. It's good to meet another bloodmage who isn't after power.
lines.common_spanish: Spanish, pata, at last! I can talk without thinking about every word.
